description: This file implements the QuicConnectivityMonitor class, which monitors and records the connectivity status of QUIC sessions, including degradation, errors, and network changes, primarily for telemetry and debugging purposes.

classes.name: QuicConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors QUIC session connectivity, tracks degraded sessions, errors, and network changes, and records metrics for analysis.

methods.name: RecordConnectivityStatsToHistograms
methods.description: Records various connectivity statistics and degradation metrics to histograms based on network notifications.

methods.name: GetNumDegradingSessions
methods.description: Returns the number of currently degrading sessions.

methods.name: GetCountForWriteErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the count of a specific write error code encountered.

methods.name: SetInitialDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Sets the initial default network handle.

methods.name: OnSessionPathDegrading
methods.description: Handles a session becoming degraded on a specific network.

methods.name: OnSessionResumedPostPathDegrading
methods.description: Handles a session resuming after degradation.

methods.name: OnSessionEncounteringWriteError
methods.description: Handles a session encountering a write error, updating error maps and metrics.

methods.name: OnSessionClosedAfterHandshake
methods.description: Handles session closure after handshake, updating error counts based on error type.

methods.name: OnSessionRegistered
methods.description: Registers a new session and updates active session count.

methods.name: OnDefaultNetworkUpdated
methods.description: Updates the default network and clears session states.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles IP address change events, clearing degraded sessions if network handles are unsupported.

methods.name: OnSessionGoingAwayOnIPAddressChange
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a session goes away due to IP address change.
